title: Random forest predicts targets of tRNA-derived fragments
summary: tRForest applies miRNA-style target features in a random forest to predict targets of tRNA-derived fragments of all classes, which the authors report improves prediction, and predictions were tested in two independent cell lines. Gene Ontology analysis suggested neuronal functions among predicted targets. The abstract gives no numeric performance metrics.
organization: University of Virginia School of Medicine

evidence.tested: Experimental validation of predicted tRF targets in two independent cell lines.
evidence.unknown: No numeric metrics in the abstract; extent of experimental testing not stated; full text not reviewed.
